name: steelman
description: Two-stage bilateral steelman analysis for difficult decisions and disputed ideas.

interface.longDescription: Builds the strongest cases for and against a position, isolates the decisive crux, asks one key question, and gives a clear judgment only after the answer.
defaultPrompt: Steelman both sides of this decision.
Give me the strongest case for and against my idea, then ask one decisive question.
Stress-test this proposal before giving me a verdict.
